excerpt: CUPID, the CUORE Upgrade with Particle IDentification, is a next-generation experiment to search for neutrinoless double beta decay (0νββ) and other rare events using enriched Li2 100MoO4 scintillating bolometers, in the CUORE cryostat at LNGS.
title: CUPID, the CUORE Upgrade with Particle IDentification
